san-francisco-skyline-alice-s-and-pacifi.title: San Francisco · Skyline, Alice’s and Pacific Return
san-francisco-skyline-alice-s-and-pacifi.slogan: Redwoods, ridge rhythm and ocean air in one clean Bay Area loop.
san-francisco-skyline-alice-s-and-pacifi.story: Redwoods, ridge rhythm and ocean air in one clean Bay Area loop. Out of Belmont and back again: 154 km, roughly 2 h 41 in the saddle. The stops in between: Alice’s Restaurant rider stop, Pescadero coast view and Half Moon Bay water stop. It keeps close to the shore for long stretches.

sections.advice: Alice’s Restaurant rider stop → Pescadero coast view is the reward section in San Francisco. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

sections.advice: This Pescadero coast view → Half Moon Bay water stop stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

scenicChapters.title: Kazakhstan Charyn and Kolsai Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 12 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
